send_message_to_user: send a direct message to a user by their ID with optional file attachment
send_message_to_group: send a message to an existing group conversation by conversation ID
lookup_user_id: look up a user ID by exact or fuzzy name match in the Messages CLI
create_group_conversation: create a new group conversation with at least two other participants
search_conversations: search conversations by keyword or regex pattern across message content
